title: Sleep Behaviors in Pregnancy
summary: The researchers would like to know how long pregnant women spend in different positions during the night - and how often women change positions - across pregnancy. The researchers also want to see if the sleep monitor is able to improve sleep behaviors
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* At least 28 weeks pregnant
* Receiving pre-natal care at Michigan Medicine
* Have either and Android or iPhone smartphone

Exclusion Criteria:

* Less then 28 weeks pregnant
* Receiving pre-natal care external to Michigan Medicine
* Does not poses a smartphone
